context: Land phases 1-2 first (small, immediately kills textual conflicts), then 3-4. Keep the absolute ceiling enforced until the delta guard has run green for a week. Wall-clock budget (WS1.4) is deliberately deferred until 4 weeks of dev-loop-metrics-ci-failure-baseline data exist.
description:
WS1 of _project/planning/ci-failure-reduction-plan.md. fast_test_lane_policy.json is the 2nd most-touched file in the repo (10 PRs since 2026-06-20; 8 ceiling bumps in the week of 07-16..07-22; ~30 documented bumps in _ceiling_note including two multi-PR 'composed byte-identical bump' episodes). Root causes: (a) bumps use minimal headroom (+5..+33) so the next test-adding PR retrips; (b) the justification log is one JSON string so any two bumps conflict textually; (c) the check is absolute, not base-relative, so two independently-green PRs compose over the ceiling after both merge (strict checks are off).

Phased fix: (1) move _ceiling_note to an append-only _project/config/fast_lane_ceiling_log.md with merge=union in .gitattributes; (2) bump quantum +500 with resulting headroom >= 250, plus a WARNING from timing_policy_check.py when headroom < 100 so the bump lands before the violation; (3) persist develop's fast-lane collected count from develop-post-merge (it already runs ci-lint and prints the count) and enforce a base-relative delta (start: +150) in the PR lint lane, demoting the absolute ceiling to a post-merge/nightly backstop; (4) auto-ratchet: scheduled job opens a mechanical chore PR bumping +500 with a generated log entry when headroom < 100. End state: feature PRs never edit the policy file.

anti_patterns.dont: Bump with minimal working headroom (+5..+33) ever again
anti_patterns.instead: +500 quantum, resulting headroom >= 250, warning fires at < 100
anti_patterns.why: Guarantees the next test-adding PR retrips the ceiling - this caused ~30 bumps since April

anti_patterns.dont: Delete the absolute ceiling when the delta guard lands
anti_patterns.instead: Keep the auto-ratcheted absolute backstop post-merge/nightly
anti_patterns.why: Delta-only allows slow unbounded lane growth (+149 per PR forever)

anti_patterns.dont: Hand-compose byte-identical policy bumps across queued PRs
anti_patterns.instead: Delta guard + auto-ratchet make feature-PR bumps unnecessary
anti_patterns.why: That is manual merge-queue management; it cost two multi-PR choreography episodes in July

preserves.behavior: An absolute lane-size backstop remains enforced somewhere (post-merge/nightly) at every phase - never delta-only
develop-post-merge safety net stays active (see dev-loop-step-6-queue-decision-gate must-preserve)
forbidden_marker_expressions and forbidden_path_substrings enforcement in timing_policy_check.py is unchanged

verifications.description: Policy check passes strict on the reworked layout
Ceiling log exists and merges by union
No feature PR touches the policy JSON over a 2-week window post-land

work_units.summary: Split _ceiling_note into _project/config/fast_lane_ceiling_log.md (append-only, dated entries) + .gitattributes merge=union; JSON keeps only the number
Encode bump policy in timing_policy_check.py: WARNING when headroom < 100; document +500 quantum / >=250 headroom convention in the log header
Persist develop fast-lane collected count from develop-post-merge (Actions cache or repo variable) for PR-lane consumption
Base-relative delta guard in the PR lint lane (fail when pr_count - develop_count > 150; absolute ceiling becomes warn-only in PR lane, enforced post-merge/nightly)
Auto-ratchet: scheduled job opens a mechanical chore PR (+500, generated log entry) when headroom < 100
DECISION GATE (needs 4 weeks of baseline metrics): wall-clock lane budget in the PR test job; demote count checks to advisory if adopted
